scope: Compiled N32768 lean-basis current default48-bit selector payload planning, compared with host memory and paper Section8.2. Not a measured timing breakdown or proof of cause for the whole runtime gap.
paper_setup: Section8.2: dual-socket AMD EPYC7K62,1TB DDR4-3200, SMT disabled. Table7 high precision measurements use48 CPU cores.
evaluation_implementation: Current file-backed factors load raw selector groups and prepare exact NTT chunks on each selector pass; compatible-key reuse skips key generation but does not eliminate these per-pass NTT transforms.
paper_storage_observation: Section5 says sparse-operator nonzero values are the NTT coefficients stored in the corresponding selector components; the torus port instead reconstructs exact convolutions from small limbs.
